title: ShardSMP
description: ShardSMP is a Minecraft Server where you try to become rich by selling any item in the game.
body:
## 📈 | Welcome to ShardSMP
> **SHARDSMP** is a Europe-based **SHOP SURVIVAL** Server with many unique features & an active player base! When you like to player servers such DonutSMP, EuropeMC or Toxiss Survival, then you will love **SHARDSMP**! 🪻

## WHAT DO WE OFFER?
>  🗺️ **WEEKLY EVENTS** - We will host CrystalPVP, UHC, Kill the Dragon Events every week!            
>  💵 **BALANCED ECONOMY**-  Earning money is neither too hard or too easy - it's just perfect!                                                                                                      
>  📅 **EU SERVER CONNECTION** - European players enjoy a stable & smooth ping!                         
>  🗡️ **PVP ZONE** - Kill other players in our PVP Zone without getting trapped!                            
>  🤺 **DUELS** - Compete against other players in our casual queue.                                      
>  ⚙️ **CONSTANT UPDATES** - We constantly update the server, so you never get bored!                  
>  💻 **UNIQUE GUIs & SYSTEMS** - Our GUIs & Server Systems are renewed and better than ever           before!                                                                                                   
>  🎢 **TAX DEATHS** - Receive 5% of the Money from your opponent by just killing him!                    
>  🎁 **GIFTCARDS** - Buy giftcards with ingame money just like in real life!                                              
>  🛏️ **PLAYERWARPS** - Create public warps and allow any player to teleport there any time!                   
>  🪙 **BITCOIN** - Invest in bitcoin with ingame money just like in real life!                          
>  🌻 **CHILL PLAYERBASE** - Our community is very friendly - get teammates very easily!                  
>  🪨 **BEDROCK SUPPORT + COMPATIBILITY** - We redesigned the Bedrock scoreboard to ensure it displays correctly and doesn’t appear broken like on many other servers.                                    
... and so much more!                                                                                   

📈 **SHARDSMP.NET | 19132**                                                                       
🛒 https://www.shardsmp.net
